obligations.subject: Materialized consumer context identity
obligations.trigger: Read-only admission consumes a current semantic bundle with materialized disk projections
obligations.state_before: Bundle and disk projections are distinct inputs
obligations.state_after: Each disk context matches its owning bundle projection; missing, ambiguous or changed context blocks before workers or run creation
obligations.expected_behavior: Compare every materialized disk agent-context to its corresponding semantic-bundle projection and reject the complete invalid-context family
obligations.observable_result: With an otherwise valid bundle, missing, duplicate/ambiguous or changed context produces a blocking read-only result before any run or worker
forbidden_result: Starting a worker or creating a run with invalid disk context

obligations.subject: Actual consumer input resolution
obligations.trigger: Admission checks a bound execution command and selector surface
obligations.state_before: A syntactically valid bundle may still contain an unconsumable argv or selector
obligations.state_after: The actual consumer command, target, fixture and static selector reader validates consumability without test imports or product observation
obligations.expected_behavior: Reuse the actual consumer resolution path to reject unconsumable argv/selector bindings while keeping inspection read-only
obligations.observable_result: Consumer-backed cases resolve argv, targets, fixtures and static selector or report the exact binding failure; no test is imported or executed

obligations.subject: Planned absent test admission
obligations.trigger: Admission reaches a test path legally declared planned but not materialized
obligations.state_before: Q2 has not authored that test
obligations.state_after: The planned path remains Q2 work without invented assertion mappings or RED
obligations.expected_behavior: Preserve legal planned absent tests without asserting current case or failure evidence
obligations.observable_result: Admission accepts the legal planned contract, identifies Q2 work and creates no assertion mapping or observed RED
forbidden_result: Rejecting absence alone despite a valid planned declaration

obligations.subject: Legal expected-red rule reuse
obligations.trigger: Admission checks an executable behavior contract
obligations.state_before: The current expected-red binding rule owns legality
obligations.state_after: The existing legal expected-red binding checks remain authoritative
obligations.expected_behavior: Reuse current legal expected-red binding checks rather than widening role eligibility
obligations.observable_result: A contract missing its required legal RED role still blocks through the existing owning check
forbidden_result: Bypassing the existing RED binding rule

obligations.subject: Exact consumer dependency projection
obligations.trigger: Consumer admission receives explicit slice dependency fields
obligations.state_before: The obligation graph is the existing authority
obligations.state_after: Explicit dependency projection matches that graph; wrong edges reject without mutation
obligations.expected_behavior: Validate exact obligation-to-slice dependency projection using existing rules and do not silently repair at consumption
obligations.observable_result: Wrong explicit slice edges produce the existing graph diagnostic and all input bytes remain unchanged
forbidden_result: Silently filling or changing explicit consumer dependencies

obligations.subject: Unsupported static selector fallback
obligations.trigger: A declaration has an unsupported static assertion mapping
obligations.state_before: The actual declared selector is the fallback
obligations.state_after: The existing declared-selector fallback remains intact and is not runtime proof
obligations.expected_behavior: Retain the established static-mapping fallback without promoting it to assertion or case evidence
obligations.observable_result: Unsupported mapping preserves the declared selector and the read-only result claims no runtime case proof

obligations.subject: Shared stage-appropriate consumer checks
obligations.trigger: VDD and Quick Dev inspect their respective available candidate representations
obligations.state_before: Each owner has an existing stage boundary
obligations.state_after: Both consumers use the same read-only checks appropriate to their current representation
obligations.expected_behavior: Share owning reader/rules between VDD candidate inspection and Quick Dev consumption without requiring future materialized inputs prematurely
obligations.observable_result: VDD candidate checks and Quick Dev disk checks use common resolution semantics; planned missing tests remain legal and applicable transitive dependency drift invalidates old proof
forbidden_result: Forcing future disk artifacts into pre-V3 admission
Losing shared-execution or stage-reentry freshness checks
